events.name: Cow Makeup
events.description: You dab brown spots on your cheeks in front of a black backdrop, turn your head, and on the cut you're a full cow: cow-print skin, pink snout, horns, floppy ears and a brass cowbell.

events.name: GTA 6 Vice City Story
events.description: Your own GTA-style story in 15 seconds: a big neon close-up of you on a wet Vice City street at night, a deal by a black convertible at sunset, car keys slid across a diner table, a police chase in a black muscle car, and you standing by the car under a pink neon sign at the end.

events.name: Here We Go Again (GTA Meme)
events.description: Thrown out in a sunny back alley, you get up, look around, sigh 'Ah sh*t, here we go again' and walk off down the alley: the classic GTA meme, live-action style.

events.name: La Mujer del Pelotero Dance
events.description: You and a friend in evening dresses at a party, side by side by the kitchen counter, doing the La Mujer del Pelotero hand routine in sync to a low phone: hands up, wrists crossed over the face, forearms rolling, a finger pointed up to finish.

events.name: You Are Nice, You Are Pretty
events.description: Your pet sits up on a green sofa with its paws together, looks into the camera wide-eyed while the sweet little voice says it's nice, pretty, smart and your friend, then melts into a sleepy, blissed-out squint.
